# Assessment Overview

This folder contains supplementary assessment artifacts generated during architecture analysis.

## Available Documents

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - Application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, API contracts, and communication sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, ER diagram, and data ownership analysis.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, secrets, and runtime settings.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core business workflows, rules, and sequence diagram.
